verdict.rationale: Formant documents the building blocks of this workflow as its own features: configurable alerts with automated incident detection, automated incident response workflows, orchestration that "dispatches help the moment something looks wrong," low-latency teleoperation for operator takeover, and intervention records. Nothing documents an actual intervention queue that autonomy failures are routed into, or a mechanism for handing control back to autonomy after the operator resolves the issue. missing for 10: documented human intervention queue/routing of autonomy failures, operator claim/resolve workflow, explicit hand-back-to-autonomy mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration.
